sourceState: Top-level benchmarkReport, localPairedRounds, firstUse, fullCorpusMemory and workersPaired describe the SIMD milestone (assets.simd), measured as uncommitted changes on 0d34d18. reviewCacheCleanup describes the subsequent cache revision (assets.final).

reviewCacheCleanup.method: Each local run warms both modules then executes six paired passes with order reversed per pass; medians exclude the first two passes. Both modules use the same src/core.ts wrapper. Each measured frame is decoded and compared with its input.
